title: Adjusting to table and stack context

questions.prompt: Stacks are 200bb instead of 100bb. Which hands gain?

choices.text: Suited connectors and suited aces that can make strong hands
Dominated offsuit broadways that make one pair
Nothing. Depth does not change preflop.

questions.explanation: Deeper stacks pay implied odds for suited and connected hands and punish one-pair domination.

choices.text: Call more suited connectors because implied odds increased
Prefer hands that are ahead now. Speculative hands lose implied odds.

questions.explanation: At 30bb you cannot win a huge pot when you flop a set, and you are committed more often with one pair.

questions.prompt: A tight table open-folds too much. A sound exploit is…

choices.text: Open wider in late position and fold when they play back

questions.explanation: Steal more against folders. Give up when a tight player 3-bets, because their continue is strong.

questions.prompt: A live straddle is posted by the under-the-gun seat. This trainer does not deal straddles yet. Conceptually, you should…

choices.text: Ignore it. A straddle is the same as no blind.
Treat the straddler as an early-position open.
Fold for the rest of the orbit by rule.
Treat the straddle as a bigger big blind. The first voluntary actor sits to the left of the straddle.

questions.explanation: A straddle changes who is in the blinds. Do not play a 9-handed UTG chart from the seat that now acts after the straddle.
